title: A group in an icon shows what an icon needs, not page layout rows
goal: Picking a group in an icon fills the panel with page layout rows (Arrangement, Hug and Fixed, Padding, Scale) that mean nothing in a drawing, and they push the animation rows down. Someone drawing an icon should see only rows that change their icon.
notes: Seen three times now: audits of 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 (icon-place-tag-1-box-sc.png) and 9-grouped in the-whole-icon-workflow-walk. Picture: queue/audits/2026-11-07-icon-workflow-group-panel-sc.png. Not a bug, a panel that speaks about the wrong job; the panel rows are not covered by the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its, which moves one-shot buttons.
acceptance: A group picked on an Icon picture or in an icon frame shows no Layout section at Next defaults
A shape picked there shows no Columns section
Layout still shows for a group on a Design picture
